facts.statement: A community event called the Robgoblin party was held at the Robgoblin camp north of the Villadelago teleport stone, on Server 1, for players in the Americas/Latin America.
facts.quote: Jueves 13 de enero del 2011 1500 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The same Robgoblin party was repeated for UK and Europe on Server 1 the following day.
facts.quote: viernes 14 de enero del 2011 0900 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico/1800 hrs Timepo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Evento Comunitario: Fiesta Robgoblin)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official community event notice announcing a Robgoblin party at the Robgoblin camp north of the Villadelago teleport stone, where the mage trainer Palorroto is located. It gives the event times for Server 1 for the Americas and Europe and explains how players find community events through the Game Guide calendar. The post itself is dated only as 'Posted 4 months, 3 weeks ago' relative to capture, so its exact posting date is unknown.
